note: A table with its own border participates in conflict resolution: the table's 10px border wins the outer edges over borderless cells (and its full width lands inside the table's border box, half of it beyond the grid), while a wider 10px cell border beats a 4px table border on the outer edge of the second table. Cell rects start one strut half inside the table box in both cases.
